content:
While we’re all ragging on these images, I’ll add that the PTFE tubes are clearly not measured correctly on that right side of the printer (image left) in the second image. 

Jokes aside, I’m sure these images were taken very early on in the development of this manual and either haven’t yet been updated or possibly won’t be. Also, someone made note of the PTFE tube paired with the head cable in the first image. I presume this was used as a support structure for the head cable early on before they adopted the nylon filament (“string,” as they call it).
FYI. The second picture does not show the filament sensor routed through the opening at the top of the xBuddy board.
The image here shows a PTFE tube attached to the head cable. This does not exist.
You won the IF Design award and now there are two (sensor) cables hanging into the wild?  I'm "surprised".
